integrity: Exact integer enumeration using independent forbidden-pattern/row-chain predicates, orbit character sums and a separate Walsh butterfly; finite exhaustive certificate, not an infinite theorem or an independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The new complete amplitude census concerns binary 4-by-4 matrices only. All-size Fourier support is an elementary consequence of the known enumeration; exact minimum gaps in higher sizes and historical priority remain open.
title: The first square Fourier-gap jump for binary lonesum matrices
